headline: Minister of Finance Presents Budget to Parliament - "Growth Rate to Be 3% From 2027"
summary: Cyprus's finance minister presented the budget to parliament, estimating 2026 economic growth at 3.1%. The forecast is set against challenges from the Russia-Ukraine war and the Middle East conflict.
why: The state budget sets fiscal policy, spending and tax direction for Cyprus, and growth forecasts shape investor views of the island economy and its sovereign credit.
